briefdescription.para: This function calculates the invalid mask and PPK offset based on the selected PPK.

para.verbatim: PPK 0/1/2 are supported on all platforms. Extended PPKs (3+) are platform-specific: - VERSAL_2VP_P (standalone): PPK 3-8 always available. - versal / versal_2vp with PLM_EN_ADD_PPKS: PPK 3-4 optional, gated by XLoader_IsAdditionalPpkFeatureEnabled. - versal_net / versal_2ve_2vm / versal_gen2_tr: PPK 0-2 only.
